scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.api:dev: uv run --directory apps/api --extra dev uvicorn sunovate_api.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:lint: uv run --directory apps/api --extra dev ruff check . ../../tests ../../scripts
scripts.api:typecheck: uv run --directory apps/api --extra dev mypy sunovate_api
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api --extra dev alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: uv run --directory apps/api --extra dev python -m sunovate_api.db.seed
scripts.db:sql: uv run --directory apps/api --extra dev alembic upgrade head --sql
scripts.search:eval: uv run --directory apps/api --extra dev python -m sunovate_api.evaluation.search_recall
